title: What has happened has happened
odia: ରାଧା କହିଲେ ଦୂତୀ କି, ଯାହା ହେଇଚି ସେତିକି...!!!
literal_meaning: Radha told the messenger: what has happened is that much.
explanation: A resigned response when events have become difficult to contain: further words cannot undo what has occurred.
meaning_odia: କଥା ହାତରୁ ଖସିଗଲେ ଯାହା ଘଟିଛି ତାହାକୁ ମାନିନେବାର ଭାବ ଏଠି ରହିଛି।
usage_example: After an announcement has already gone out, arguing over the unsent draft no longer changes it. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The source invokes Radha and a female messenger but names no underlying poem or episode; none is supplied here.
